 ‘General Hospital’ star Cameron Mathison reflects on ‘red flag’ that led to kidney cancer diagnosis 
 By 
 Tamantha Ryan 
 Published 
 Nov. 17, 2026, 11:30 a.m. ET 
 See more of our coverage in your search results. 
 Make Page Six a Preferred Source 
 Cameron Mathison noticed “red flags” before he was diagnosed with kidney cancer. 
 In an interview with Fox News , the “General Hospital” actor said he “just knew something was wrong” after years of bloodwork, gut microbiome testing and hormone evaluations.
 “I was a guy trying to do it right, but like, I was alluding to, I was very extreme,” he told the outlet.

 Cameron Mathison (seen above in the hospital with his two kids) noticed “red flags” before his kidney cancer diagnosis. cameronmathison/Instagram 
 6 
 “I was doing these extreme things, and I was getting the blood tests, and … things were just off … they were like red flags,” the soap opera star (seen above getting an MRI) told Fox News. cameronmathison/Instagram

 “And I was doing these extreme things, and I was getting the blood tests, and … things were just off … they were like red flags,” Mathison, 57, added.
 In 2019, the soap opera star was diagnosed with renal cell carcinoma (RCC) after an MRI revealed a tumor. Per Cleveland Clinic , RCC is the most common type of kidney cancer and often doesn’t cause symptoms.
 “I have a health situation that I want to share with you all🙏🏼 There are many reasons I love social media, staying connected with you all, sharing fun experiences… well this time I’m asking for your help,” the “All My Children” alum wrote on Instagram at the time.
 6 
 Mathison (seen above in a scene from “General Hospital” in August 2025) was diagnosed with renal cell carcinoma (RCC) in 2019. Disney via Getty Images 
 6 
 The “All My Children” alum (seen above at the Daytime Emmy Awards in 2024) said the tumor had not spread to other organs. Getty Images

 “About a month ago, I had an MRI for some gut issues I’ve been having, and during that MRI they found a tumor on my right kidney. It’s consistent with Renal Cell Carcinoma … or kidney cancer,” he added.
 Despite the devastating news, Mathison revealed that the tumor had not metastasized.
 “The good news is that it hasn’t spread to any other organs,” he penned. “They say my healthy lifestyle and diet has no doubt helped keep it from growing and spreading to other areas, as doctors think it’s been growing in me for minimum 10 years.”
 6 
 Mathison (seen above with his family at a film premiere in August 2016) thanked his then-wife, Vanessa Arevalo, and their two kids for being supportive. Getty Images 
 6 
 The actor is now dating Taelyr Robinson (seen above in a gym selfie with Mathison). cameronmathison/Instagram 
 “I am extremely lucky that we found it early,” the Hallmark star explained.
 Mathison concluded his post by thanking his then-wife, Vanessa Arevalo, and their two kids, son Lucas Arthur and daughter Leila Emmanuelle, for being “absolutely amazing” and supportive.
 The actor and Arevalo split in 2024 after 22 years of marriage. He is now dating 33-year-old model Taelyr Robinson .
